meta.title: Ballmania — marble shooting reinvented
meta.description: Chain marble shooting reinvented: a six-world campaign, new modes, spectacular explosions. Free, no sign-up, on mobile and desktop.

home.pitch: Six worlds to conquer, chain explosions and modes you have never played.

game.help: Aim with the mouse or your finger, shoot by clicking or releasing. Keyboard: arrows to aim (Shift for precision), Space to shoot, X to swap, Escape to pause.
game.starsLabel: {count} star out of 3 | {count} star out of 3 | {count} stars out of 3

spectacular.name: Spectacular
spectacular.hint: Shards, lightning, shock waves and slow motion

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.comingSoon: Coming soon: finish the previous world to open it.

nebula.name: Nebula
nebula.tagline: Orbs of glass and energy at the heart of the stars.

neon.name: Neon
neon.tagline: Walls and prisms: bounce your shots.

abyss.name: Abyss
abyss.tagline: Pull a ball out and send it elsewhere.

jewel.name: Jewels
jewel.tagline: Mix colours to create new ones.

volcano.name: Volcano
volcano.tagline: Flip the switches to divert the lava.

singularity.name: Singularity
singularity.tagline: A black hole bends every shot.

hints.aim: Aim at the chain and shoot: three balls of the same colour explode.
hints.swap: Swap the loaded ball with the next one: tap the shooter or press X.
hints.reaction: When two pieces of the same colour meet, they explode in turn: that's a chain reaction.
hints.colours: A fourth colour joins the game.
hints.twin: Two chains at once: watch both holes.
hints.colossus: The Colossus pushes the chain: blow up balls right next to it to hurt it.
